overall: The AG found the Marshfield Board of Public Works violated the Open Meeting Law by approving seven sets of minutes late and by discussing an unlisted complaint topic at its June 17, 2024 meeting; two other minutes were timely.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve nine sets of minutes from meetings held Feb 2023 to May 2024. Seven were approved late; two (May 13 and May 20, 2024) were timely.
allegations.key_passage: Where the Board did not approve these seven sets of minutes within the timeframe required by the Open Meeting Law, we find that the Board violated the law by failing to approve these minutes in a timely manner.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed the first Open Meeting Law complaint at its June 17, 2024 meeting without listing that topic on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not specifically including on the notice a topic to discuss the Open Meeting Law complaint.

allegations.summary: Not alleged by the complainant; the AG noted the June 17, 2024 minutes omit any reference to the Board's discussion of the complaint and recommended amending them.
allegations.key_passage: We recommend that the Board amend its June 17, 2024, meeting minutes to include the Board's discussion of the complaint.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.

Create and approve the minutes of the meetings held on February 27, 2023, July 10, 2023, September 11, 2023, September 28, 2023, and October 16, 2023, within 45 days of the letter, if not already done.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. In addition, we order the Board to create and approve the minutes of the meetings held on February 27, 2023, July 10, 2023, September 11, 2023, September 28, 2023, and October 16, 2023, within 45 days of the date of this letter, if it has not already done so.
